lines.speaker: lonnie
lines.said: Can I jump in? Scoring's half of it, Royce. Denver is 6 and 2, more wins than anybody else in this conversation. And what's their profile? A defense that's solid in the middle of the pack and takes the ball away. No hole big enough to lose you a game.
lines.problem: Denver has more wins than anybody else in this conversation.: Buffalo also has 6 wins (6-1), so Denver is tied with Buffalo, not ahead. KC and Detroit have 5. (contradicted)
lines.now: Can I jump in? Scoring's half of it, Royce. Denver is 6 and 2, as many wins as Buffalo has, and more than Kansas City or Detroit. And what's their profile? A defense that's solid in the middle of the pack and takes the ball away. No hole big enough to lose you a game.

lines.speaker: royce
lines.said: Buffalo, because the team that scores the most and loses the least is the one you remember in January.
lines.problem: Buffalo loses the least.: Buffalo has one loss, but the fact pack has no league-wide loss counts, so 'the least' can't be verified. (unsupported)
lines.now: Buffalo, because the team that scores the most and loses only once is the one you remember in January.

lines.speaker: deacon
lines.said: Kansas City, because it's the only one that's top five on both sides of the ball.
lines.problem: Kansas City is the only one of these teams that is top five on both sides of the ball.: KC is 4th in offensive EPA and 4th in points allowed, but 11th in defensive EPA. The 'only one' superlative is not established by the facts. (unsupported)
lines.now: Kansas City, because it's the one that's strong on both sides of the ball: fourth in offensive EPA and fourth in points allowed.
